Gu-Landon
...We can wipe out the <Jevilun> ourselves, but@the <Zovorg> are growing more active as well,@and the situation is far from certain.
Therefore, I request your permission for an@operation with the <Agent>s, using <Larseilam>@to recover the Throne Unit.

Gu-Landon, the foe we must fight is the@<Vaula>, who appear from the <Gate of Voda>.

So-Des

(This guy's one of the Agents...)
To recover the Throne Unit, in the next@operation we will also transfer an idling@Orgo Transfer Base.
Then So-Des's Raftclans will use Larseilam to@deploy a stasis field... and move the Throne Unit@next to the Transfer Base.
And the moment the field disappears,@Granteed will be transferred here to@Gaw-La Furia.
Seems I'm the only one doing any work...
Then use it to clear your name after last time.
Al-Van, you and yours will guard@So-Des's Raftclans and the@Orgo Transfer Base.
Sir!

Don't get cocky, you lousy Agent.
Says the one who's still a Junior Knight.@Whether you can use Larseilam or not@is beside the point.
After all, you haven't even been@given a Raftclans.@Please don't talk so big.
What did you say, you...!
Enough, Jua-Mu.
...Sir.
There's something more I must tell you.@Bring the Throne Unit's pilot back alive.@That is Her Highness's order.
...What about the Bellzelute?
She said nothing of it. So I give the order.@With E-Selda gone, that prototype is useless.@Destroy it and eliminate its pilot.
(Lord Al-Van...?)
(So this one is...)

Nothing... When do we move?
As you know, the Steel Dragons are currently@on a mission to destroy the Jevilun.
Strike right after they move on to@the next city and finish fighting.
As you wish.
Indonesia, Outskirts of Jakarta
Steel Dragons
Aboard the Hagane
Hey, Rai. Know where we're headed next?
Delhi, India, I'd imagine.
What, you already heard?

...When it comes to them, don't you@know more than I do?
You think I'm working with them? Let me tell you,@if I knew who the Fury were or where their base@was, I wouldn't be here.

But...@Are you saying you don't care about the Lamaris?
It's a matter of priority.@But I don't slack off when I fight them.@I don't want to die over something stupid.

How do you know that...?
If the Fury had destroyed Mao@instead of Ashurey...@could you just stand there like that?
...There's a limit to what one person can do.@All the more so when the enemy belongs to an@organization no one knows anything about.

I'm only speaking from my own experience.
(Lord Raidiese's experience... That would be...)
(...Archibald Grims, I take it.)
So, did you get your revenge, Lieutenant?
...I didn't accomplish it alone.
I see. I'll gratefully take your advice, then.

Calvina, stay calm!

The tide hasn't turned to the enemy yet.@I'll take Granteed with my own hands!
Not an opponent so easily caught...@I'll have to go all out.
Why isn't he using that trick...?
A fair fight is a knight's duty! Here I come!
Just what are you Fury@trying to do?!
(I'm not permitted to speak of that...)
(Yes, so it was meant to be.@And yet, Lord E-Selda...)
You know, don't you?!@About the ruins in Antarctica... about Fabula Foresse!
(It's only natural that he wants the truth.)
My name is Sänger Sombold!@Knight of the Fury, face me in fair combat!
(At last, the time has come to cross blades with him...!)
Just what I wanted! Al-Van Ranks, here I come!
(Should I whittle down the Steel Dragons' forces...?)
(Does he not need that trick, or can he not use it...?@I hope this battle gives me a clue.)
Even at my age, facing a strong foe@still sets my heart racing...
But such is a swordsman's nature!@Here I come, knight of the Fury!
A duel with the wielder of the Zankantou.@I accept, head-on!
India - Delhi District
Um, Major Gilliam... thank you.@Honestly, I didn't really understand@what happened...
Based on their last failure, I figured the Fury@would transfer Granteed away right after@using that trick.
So I fired a marker with a transmitter in it@near their transfer device, for all to see.
(So that was a transmitter...)
If they transferred like that, we might learn where@the Fury's base is. Though there was no guarantee@they'd transfer straight there...
It was enough to create even a small opening@to destroy their transfer device.@As it turned out, you destroyed it for us.
I see, so that's how it was.
Then wouldn't it have been better to@put the marker on Granteed?
That way, the Fury might have noticed it.
But what if they hadn't noticed...
Right now, we don't know where the Fury's base is...@It could very well be somewhere a transmitter@can't be detected.
So that marker was mainly a tool to shake up the@Fury. If they'd seen through it, we'd have been@in trouble.
So it was a long-shot bet, unusual for you, Major.
When you win a gamble, just be happy about it.@The other side folded. All's well that ends well.
...I wonder if they really did fold.
Hm? Something bothering you, High-Leg Celeb?
H-High-Leg Celeb...
Says it like it is.
So what are you getting at?

...Not playing his card now,@saving it for a bigger hand later, eh?
You mean he knew what we were planning@and went along with it anyway?
Yes. Though I may be off the mark.
No, I wouldn't say that.

(It may have to do with Lieutenant Calvina@and Al-Van's past.)
Um... may I?
What's that?
It's close to Lieutenant Aqua's idea, but maybe@Al-Van didn't deliberately avoid that trick...
I think it's also possible@he's forbidden to use it.
A taboo, huh? Well, it'd make sense@as the reason they're not throwing@that trick at us left and right.
Either way, the marker won't work anymore.@If the Fury send in two or more Raftclans next time,@and all of them use that trick...
Yes, I know.
(Whether we can counter that depends on@us at L&E Corporation.@That's a big responsibility...)
(To let Al-Van just get away like that...!)
Lieutenant Calvina.
...I don't want to talk to anyone right now.
Yeah... I figured.
Then what?
It's not me who has business with you. It's her.
I just told you. I don't want to talk to anyone...
Don't give up on talking with that man.

Honestly... this unit is full of busybodies.
I'm not a person. I'm a <Meliores Esse>.

But I know this. If you refuse to talk,@you may lose what you could have gained.
What are you...
I once fought Josh.@But because I accepted his words,@I'm here now.

It's the same.
Pardon?
I lost my brethren too. In battle with the Steel Dragons.
(Could it be that Josh...?)
So don't give up on talking with that man.
Mind your own business. You and I are different.@I don't want sympathy. I don't need you to@understand me, either.
Josh, take her with you.
Got it. Sorry about this.@...Let's go, Raki.
(Don't give up on talking?@What good would that do?)
(Everyone at Ashurey Kreuzer@is never coming back..........)

(Instead of answering my questions, this just@made them worse. Now the only way to find out@the truth is...)
